children: The Canadian dollar weakened against the greenback on Wednesday, and the yield on benchmark government debt slipped.
was trading 0.1% lower at C$1.3936 to the greenback, or 71.76 U.S. cents, after trading in a range of 1.3916 to 1.3943.
Canadian government 10-year bond yields (CA10YT=RR) fell 3.3 basis points to 3.919%. The yield on similar U.S. government benchmark debt fell to 4.9773%.
futures fell $1.75 to $104.08 a barrel on Wednesday.
The value of building permits in Canada fell -17.3% in July, Statistics Canada said.
Canadian housing starts in August fell more than expected to 229,000 units from a revised 229,400 units the previous month, the Canada Mortgage and Housing Corporation (CMHC) said.
A survey of 9 economists polled by Reuters had forecast August housing starts rising to 240,000 units.
